tasks.short: Plan household menus around actual needs and restrictions

steps.what: Discuss employers' actual meal needs, preferences, diet restrictions and household plans
inputs: employer's actual stated needs and restrictions
actual household meal dates and guest needs
outputs: actual household menu requirements and unresolved questions

steps.what: Capture the confirmed meal requirements and restrictions in the cook's menu-planning worksheet
inputs: actual household menu requirements and unresolved questions
outputs: captured confirmed requirements with uncertain restrictions explicit

steps.what: Check existing household recipes and verified ingredient specifications against the confirmed restrictions
inputs: captured confirmed requirements with uncertain restrictions explicit
existing house recipes with verified ingredient and allergen fields
outputs: candidate recipe list with missing specifications excluded from automatic selection

steps.what: Prepare a candidate cycle menu using only eligible household recipe identifiers and actual meal requirements
inputs: candidate recipe list with missing specifications excluded from automatic selection
captured confirmed requirements with uncertain restrictions explicit
verified recipe portions and costs where available
outputs: complete proposed household menu with recipe identifiers and explicit gaps

loop.purpose: Propose a varied arrangement of existing eligible house recipes
loop.input: eligible recipe identifiers and confirmed meal requirements
loop.output: candidate menu using those identifiers only
loop.check: Deterministic membership, portion, exclusion and repeat checks; cook checks actual ingredient specifications and practical suitability, with no model as allergen authority
loop.stop: Missing specification, uncertain restriction or three failed drafts returns planning to the cook
loop.why_not_simpler: Filters handle hard exclusions; arranging variable household preferences across a menu can use bounded proposals, while fixed rotations use templates

steps.what: Choose and correct the actual menu for household preferences, safe ingredient suitability and practical cooking
inputs: complete proposed household menu with recipe identifiers and explicit gaps
captured confirmed requirements with uncertain restrictions explicit
actual ingredient specifications
outputs: complete human-chosen final household menu

steps.what: Approve the completed final household menu against the confirmed requirements and source specifications
inputs: complete human-chosen final household menu
captured confirmed requirements with uncertain restrictions explicit
outputs: approved final household menu

steps.what: Save the approved household menu in the cook's existing menu file
inputs: approved final household menu
outputs: saved household menu

tasks.design: Use existing recipe filters in {SPREADSHEET} first, then a bounded candidate-menu proposal in {DOCS} only where a fixed rotation is insufficient. The cook captures actual household restrictions, verifies source ingredient facts and chooses the complete menu; the model never declares a dish safe.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recipe checking and arranging varied eligible meals can take time after the household's actual requirements are known.
tasks.enabler_now: Structured recipe fields and bounded proposals can reuse existing verified recipes while hard exclusions remain explicit.
tasks.still_hard: Unclear dietary requirements, ingredient changes and practical food preparation require the cook and employer.
tasks.human_edge: The cook knows the household's tastes and recognises when a formally eligible recipe is unsuitable in practice.

ambition.what: Prepare another menu option from the same verified house recipes when actual meal plans change.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1–3 for household agreement and private dietary-data handling

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: recipe worksheets can filter verified ingredient fields, and bounded language-model proposals can arrange eligible recipes subject to human choice and explicit checks.

assumptions: Provisional scenario shares, not measured household cooking baselines.
House recipes and verified ingredient fields already exist; creating that library is separately counted if absent, and upkeep is charged below.
Actual requirements are obtained in s1 and captured in s2. No diet restriction, nutrition target or allergen value is inferred.
Native filters and fixed menu rotations first. If already sufficient, additional model benefit is zero.
The same-file save has no saving. Any employer message is a separate completed payload and gated send, with no hidden distribution here.
unknowns: Whether fixed rotations already cover household preferences
research_questions: Does candidate arrangement reduce effort after ingredient verification and final cook review?

already_counted.description: Check completed menu against actual restrictions and source facts

incremental.description: Maintain verified recipe fields and sample candidate-menu errors

approvals.approved_version: approved final household menu; changes return to s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 6 recipe-filtering hours +12.5 arrangement hours =18.5. Upkeep 2.5 gives central net 16%; four extra hours checking changed ingredient specifications gives high 12%. Low zero if fixed rotations already suffice or source preparation absorbs the benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Shop for or order household food and kitchen supplies

steps.what: Check actual household food stocks, kitchen supplies and equipment needs
inputs: actual kitchen stocks and equipment condition
chosen meal plans and household requirements
outputs: actual shortages and purchase needs

steps.what: Capture the actual shopping requirements, quantities and permitted substitution constraints
inputs: actual shortages and purchase needs
household purchasing limits and dietary requirements
outputs: complete actual shopping list and substitution limits

steps.what: Inspect supplier availability, pack sizes, actual prices and delivery terms for the required items
inputs: complete actual shopping list and substitution limits
current supplier catalogue and availability
outputs: checked purchasable options and actual terms

steps.what: Prepare the actual supplier basket with selected items, quantities, delivery address and permitted payment method
inputs: checked purchasable options and actual terms
complete actual shopping list and substitution limits
existing verified household delivery and authorised payment details
outputs: complete final basket, total, delivery terms, substitution settings and payment method

steps.what: Approve the completed exact basket, total, delivery destination, substitutions and payment method within household authority
inputs: complete final basket, total, delivery terms, substitution settings and payment method
household purchasing limits and dietary requirements
outputs: approved exact supplier order and payment instruction

steps.what: Place the exact approved food and kitchen-supply order with the supplier
inputs: approved exact supplier order and payment instruction
outputs: placed exact supplier order

steps.what: Authorise only the exact approved supplier charge through the approved payment method
inputs: approved exact supplier order and payment instruction
outputs: authorised exact approved charge

steps.what: Inspect actual delivered items and substitutions for quality, quantity and household suitability
inputs: actual delivered goods
placed exact supplier order
actual ingredient labels and substitution details
outputs: actual receipt findings and discrepancies

steps.what: Capture actual receipt, usable quantities and delivery discrepancies
inputs: actual receipt findings and discrepancies
outputs: complete actual household receipt record

steps.what: Approve the completed actual receipt record
inputs: complete actual household receipt record
outputs: approved final actual household receipt record

steps.what: Save the approved actual household receipt record
inputs: approved final actual household receipt record
outputs: saved actual household receipt record

tasks.design: Use existing supplier saved-list and basket features in {ECOMMERCE}, with actual household needs captured in {DOCS}. The cook checks every selected item and final charge, then separately places the order and authorises payment; actual delivery is inspected and recorded afterwards.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated catalogue inspection and basket field entry can add effort after actual household shortages are known.
tasks.enabler_now: Native supplier lists and verified delivery details can reuse known item fields while retaining final item selection.
tasks.still_hard: Freshness, substitutions and actual household suitability require the cook.
tasks.human_edge: The cook can reject a substitution that is available and similarly priced but unsuitable for the household.

ambition.what: Reduce routine order preparation while retaining purchase and receipt judgement.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1–3 for household purchasing and payment authority

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: supplier shopping sites commonly provide saved shopping lists and reusable delivery fields, while final basket and actual goods need checking.

assumptions: Provisional effort scenario, not measured household shopping baselines.
This is the ordering variant of shop-or-order. In-person selection, travel and handling remain manual where required; no avoided shopping trip is claimed as saving.
Actual shortages are checked in s1 and captured in s2; no free stock sensor, par level or generated need is assumed.
Existing verified household address and authorised payment method must be confirmed; if unavailable, setup and approval work must be counted.
Native saved-list features first. Changed price, delivery, item, substitution or charge invalidates s5 approval and stops checkout until renewed approval.
Order placement, payment authorisation and same-file save are fully retained with no saving.
unknowns: Household purchasing limits and supplier substitution controls
research_questions: Does saved-list reuse reduce net basket preparation after checking current items and prices?

already_counted.description: Check final exact basket, charge and delivery details

incremental.description: Maintain saved lists and verified household order settings

approvals.approved_version: approved exact supplier items, quantities, total, delivery and substitutions; changes return to s5
approved exact charge and payment method from s5; any changed charge requires new approval
approved final actual household receipt record; changes return to s9

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 6 supplier-view hours +8 basket-preparation hours =14. Two upkeep hours give central net 12%; two extra hours checking changed supplier packs gives high 10%. Low zero where saved lists are already used or in-person shopping provides no equivalent preparation reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep household menu and business finance records

steps.what: Collect the actual menus, receipts and other business evidence needed for the cook's records
inputs: actual menu decisions and changes
actual purchase receipts and business documents
outputs: source evidence set with dates and provenance

steps.what: Capture actual menu changes and business events that the receipts do not describe
inputs: source evidence set with dates and provenance
cook's actual knowledge of menu changes and business events
outputs: actual menu and business event entries with uncertain details explicit

steps.what: Prepare receipt-derived record fields and inspect them against the actual source documents
inputs: source evidence set with dates and provenance
approved simple record fields for date, supplier, amount and purpose
outputs: source-linked proposed receipt entries with uncertain fields flagged

loop.purpose: Extract proposed fields from actual unstructured receipts
loop.input: actual receipt images or text and fixed record-field definitions
loop.output: proposed date, supplier, amount and source reference with uncertain values blank
loop.check: Cook compares every proposed field to the receipt; deterministic totals and duplicate checks follow
loop.stop: Unreadable receipt, conflicting total or missing source returns to manual entry
loop.why_not_simpler: Structured supplier exports import directly; variable receipt images need bounded extraction if those exports are absent

steps.what: Reconcile actual receipt entries and menu/business records, resolving duplicates and missing information
inputs: source-linked proposed receipt entries with uncertain fields flagged
actual menu and business event entries with uncertain details explicit
actual source receipts
outputs: checked complete records with unresolved discrepancies explicit

steps.what: Prepare the menu and expenditure record summary using checked entries and fixed totals
inputs: checked complete records with unresolved discrepancies explicit
existing record categories and reporting period
outputs: complete menu and business record package

steps.what: Approve the completed record package against actual receipts and menu/business facts
inputs: complete menu and business record package
source evidence set with dates and provenance
outputs: approved final household business record package

steps.what: Save the approved record package in the cook's existing business records
inputs: approved final household business record package
outputs: saved menu and business record package

tasks.design: Use native supplier exports and a simple record template in {SPREADSHEET} first, with source evidence in {DOCS}. Where receipts are unstructured, a bounded extraction proposes fields for source-by-source checking; the cook still captures actual menu changes and business events.
tasks.previous_blocker: Receipt field entry, repeated duplicate checks and record totals can take time around the cook's actual event capture.
tasks.enabler_now: Simple spreadsheet checks and bounded receipt extraction can reuse actual source evidence without inferring a business purpose.
tasks.still_hard: Missing receipts, ambiguous business purpose and undocumented menu changes require the cook.
tasks.human_edge: The cook knows whether a purchase or menu change actually belonged to the household work.

ambition.what: Review actual household food expenditure and record gaps more frequently.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1–3 for household receipt privacy and record access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: spreadsheets can calculate totals and flag duplicate records, while bounded document extraction can propose receipt fields for human source checking.

assumptions: Shares and savings are provisional scenarios, not measured current recordkeeping baselines.
Actual source evidence is collected in s1; non-receipt facts are explicitly captured by the cook in s2. No upstream structured event feed is assumed.
Native receipt export and spreadsheet templates first; use no model where structured fields are already available.
The extraction does not invent an unreadable value, expense category or tax treatment. Missing information remains flagged.
The same-workbook save has no saving. Reconcile overlap with menu planning and shopping receipt capture before adding role savings.
research_questions: Does extraction reduce net field entry after every proposed value is checked?

already_counted.description: Check complete records against actual receipts and events

incremental.description: Maintain record categories and extraction fields and handle source-format changes

approvals.approved_version: approved final household business record package; edits return to s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 15 receipt-field hours +8 fixed-reconciliation hours +4 summary hours =27. Three upkeep hours give central net 24%; six extra hours correcting poor receipt extraction gives high 18%. Low zero if native exports already cover the work or verification absorbs the benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct household kitchen operations and food service

steps.what: Review the actual meal plan, household timing and kitchen constraints for the service
inputs: actual chosen menu and household meal timing
actual kitchen and equipment constraints
outputs: checked service requirements and conflicts

steps.what: Organise the actual kitchen workspace, equipment and sequence of food activities
inputs: checked service requirements and conflicts
actual kitchen workspace and available supplies
outputs: actual organised kitchen and chosen work sequence

steps.what: Direct the actual kitchen and food-related activities, adjusting timing and resolving practical problems
inputs: actual organised kitchen and chosen work sequence
actual food preparation progress and household changes
outputs: actual directed activities and resolved or outstanding kitchen issues

steps.what: Direct and check the actual presentation and serving of food for the household
inputs: actual prepared food and household service needs
actual directed activities and resolved or outstanding kitchen issues
outputs: actual completed service and relevant follow-up facts

steps.what: Capture actual kitchen changes, outstanding issues and any needed service follow-up in the existing kitchen note
inputs: actual completed service and relevant follow-up facts
actual directed activities and resolved or outstanding kitchen issues
outputs: complete actual kitchen service note

steps.what: Approve the completed actual kitchen service note
inputs: complete actual kitchen service note
outputs: approved final actual kitchen service note

steps.what: Save the approved actual kitchen service note
inputs: approved final actual kitchen service note
outputs: saved actual kitchen service note

tasks.design: Configure a simple service-plan view from existing menus in {DOCS} and household timing in {CALENDAR}. The cook organises and directs the real kitchen and service, then captures actual changes separately; a template does not replace those observations or decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Looking across an existing menu and household timings can repeat preparation before kitchen work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document links and calendar views can show the chosen plan and actual timing together.
tasks.still_hard: Food readiness, presentation and adapting to actual household changes remain hands-on judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The cook sees, tastes and adjusts the real service when the plan no longer fits.

ambition.what: Make the chosen service plan easier to inspect while retaining practical kitchen direction.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1–2 for household agreement and private calendar access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked menu documents and calendar views can reduce repeated service-plan lookup; actual kitchen direction and serving remain physical work.

assumptions: This is a provisional scenario, not a claim that a household currently keeps elaborate kitchen logs.
Existing actual menus and timing are inputs. The note represents only already-needed changes or outstanding issues; if no record is needed, remove its baseline effort rather than invent paperwork.
No kitchen staff are assumed; direction may mean the cook organising their own activities.
Native plan views first. Actual organisation, presentation, service and note capture have no saving; same-file save has no saving.
Menu planning and business recordkeeping may overlap with plan lookup and notes here; reconcile those hours before role aggregation.
unknowns: Whether the existing plan is already visible in one place
Whether any actual service note is needed
research_questions: Is repeated plan lookup material enough to justify even simple configuration?

already_counted.description: Check the completed actual service note if one is already needed

approvals.approved_version: approved final actual kitchen service note; edits return to s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only plan lookup changes: 15*(1-0.60)=6 gross hours. One upkeep hour gives central net 5%; two extra hours checking household timing changes gives high 3%. Low zero if the current menu is already immediately visible; no physical kitchen or record-save saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: household employer: confirm actual dietary needs, budgets and meal timing
supplier: provide current item facts and actual delivery
role.ambitious_version: A household cook with less menu and record preparation, retaining personal knowledge of the household, purchase judgement and hands-on kitchen direction.
